videos.subtitle_summary: 이재명 대통령이 지방선거 당일 발생한 투표용지 부족 사태에 대해 강한 유감을 표명하며, 행정부의 모든 권한과 책임을 동원해 원인을 명확히 규명하고 책임자를 엄벌하라고 지시했습니다. 또한 국민 참정권 훼손이 재발하지 않도록 신뢰할 수 있는 대책을 조속히 마련할 것을 요구했으며, 이는 선관위에 대한 직접적인 제재가 아닌 책임 있는 조치를 촉구하는 것이라고 청와대는 설명했습니다. 아울러 대통령은 2년차 임기를 맞아 국정 속도 배가를 위해 새로 선출된 지방정부와 적극 협력하겠다는 의지를 밝혔습니다.

videos.subtitle_summary:
The user wants me to summarize a YouTube video caption in Korean, around 500 characters, using only Korean (no English), and summarize the key content in 3-5 sentences.
Let me analyze the caption content:
1. Oh Se-hoon (National Power Party) won the Seoul mayoral election for the 5th term (first time in history)
2. He was behind early in vote counting but won by about 1% (50,000 votes) - a comeback victory
3. He called it "victory of common sense" and emphasized checks and balances in democracy
4. He criticized the opposition's special prosecutor bill regarding presidential veto
5. Jeong Won-ho (Democratic Party), who was leading early, conceded defeat
6. Jeong Won-ho had controversies about past assault allegations and lack of experience
7. Oh Se-hoon overcame various negative issues (GTX construction issues, overpass collapse) and succeeded in conservative rallying in Han River belt
Key points to include:
Oh Se-hoon's historic 5th term victory (first ever)
Narrow margin comeback (about 1%, 50,000 votes)
Defeat of Jeong Won-ho (Democratic Party) who was considered strong candidate
Oh's comment about "victory of common sense" and democracy's checks and balances
Jeong's concession and reflection on his shortcomings
